subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Which status fields should be suppressible per agent, and must filtering apply identically to rendered cards and structured `session_status` details?
rationale: The clutter request could be cosmetic, but the linked cross-agent disclosure use case requires an explicit information boundary; filtering structured data also changes an established tool contract.

options.title: Filter both outputs
options.body: Define approved sensitive sections and remove them from rendered and structured status output for configured agents while preserving current defaults.

options.title: Cosmetic card hiding
options.body: Allow the visible card to be hidden while documenting that authorized structured details remain available.

options.title: Keep current diagnostics
options.body: Reject the new configuration surface and retain the existing explicit diagnostic output contract.

recommendation.title: Filter both outputs
recommendation.body: Define approved sensitive sections and remove them from rendered and structured status output for configured agents while preserving current defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate from recent merges, direct code contribution, area history, and prior issue-specific review.
